title: no-verify-guard: git commit --no-verify forbidden
desc: Blocks git commit --no-verify which bypasses pre-commit and pre-push hooks. Hooks enforce CP949, pace, and knowledge gates.
steps: SAFETY: Catches any git commit command with --no-verify flag. Hooks (pre-commit, pre-push) enforce critical guards: CP949 encoding check, pace gates, knowledge update gates. Skipping them lets broken or unsafe commits through.

SOLUTION: Fix the underlying hook failure instead of bypassing it. If a hook fires, read the error message and address the root cause. To delegate the commit to a safer model, use: Agent.cmd --model opus 'commit message here'

PREVENTION: Never use git commit --no-verify. Hooks are safety rails, not obstacles. If you hit a hook failure you do not understand, read the guard skill (wkappbot skill read <guard-name>) to find the specific escape.
